input.question: Can someone explain what a mortgage is (LI5)?
input.ground_truth: A mortgage is simply a loan that a bank gives you so that you can buy a house. Most people don't have enough money on hand to pay the full price for a house so they will get a loan from the bank, called a mortgage, that is to be used strictly for the purchase of a house. The bank requires you to pay back a certain amount of the loan, with interest, every month just like any other loan. If you stop paying your mortgage the bank has the legal right to foreclose on your home, which means that they can force you to leave and sell the house to get their money back. Once you pay back your mortgage in full the bank no longer has any legal claim on your house.

I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

That sounds like a wonderful and thoughtful morning routine! Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Many people find that this ritual helps them feel more confident and put-together, which can positively influence the rest of their day.

If you enjoy the process, there’s no need to rush it. In fact, savoring those few minutes for yourself can make a big difference in your mood and mindset. Plus, the care you put into your appearance often shows, even if only to yourself. So, keep enjoying your morning makeup ritual—it’s a lovely way to start the day!

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Can someone explain what a mortgage is (LI5)?

Answer:

response.prediction: Sure! Imagine you really, really want a big toy castle, but you don’t have all the money right now to buy it. So, you ask a grown-up (like a bank) to help you. You promise that every week, you’ll give them a little bit of money until you’ve given them enough to buy the whole castle. While you’re paying them back, the castle belongs to you, but the grown-up remembers that you borrowed the money to buy it. That promise and the money you pay every week is called a "mortgage." It helps you buy something big, like a house, by letting you pay for it little by little over a long time.
